sourceRefs.locator: The Oxford Handbook of the Merovingian World, pp. 772–774 and figs. 34.1–34.3. River settlements, two moneyers at Dorestad before its later port, Madelinus in the 630s and 640s and possible uses for gold coins.
Object 800000085493, De Bast 113. Obverse, weight 1.19 g, diameter 12 mm, collection range 600–670 and CC0 file statement.
Object 18208309, legends and commentary after the bibliography. Parallel specimen. The name is also known at Maastricht and probably continued after the moneyer’s death.

labels.en: Issues in the name of Madelinus at Dorestad

note.de: Tys ordnet diese Prägetätigkeit den 630er und 640er Jahren zu. Einzelstücke, darunter das Genter Exemplar, sind weiter datiert.
note.en: Tys places this minting in the 630s and 640s. Individual coins, including the Ghent specimen, have wider catalogue dates.
